scope_notes.L2: All35 verified single-stream headers: last printed per-stream cumulative L2 counters describe declared trace total; not whole-application numerical correctness.
scope_notes.DRAM: Global cumulative issued read atoms/payload bytes; not unique cacheline count.
scope_notes.reservations: Rejected reservation attempts, not unique misses or lost transactions.
scope_notes.gpu_stall_dramfull: Printed alias of gpu_stall_icnt2mem; increments for an ICNT packet waiting while the subpartition is full. It sums over subpartitions and is neither DRAM queue delay nor nonoverlapping application cycles.
scope_notes.latency: Last printed average; missing is not zero, and no average is treated as a weighted whole-application metric.
scope_notes.MSHR: Frozen proof lacks reason fields. Targeted complete closed raw sidecar proves heartwall P0/M8/M16 MSHR_MERGE_ENRTY_FAIL counts 241/207/144 and vectorAdd DH-E384 MISS_QUEUE_FULL read/write counts. Other cases/reasons remain unextracted/None, not zero.
scope_notes.service: Raw cumulative finite-service sums across retired observations, potentially overlapping between requests/SMs; sum deltas cannot be equated to global cycle deltas.
scope_notes.causality: Matched counter changes are associations, not isolated proof of replacement/order/scheduling causation.
scope_notes.uniform_profiles: No per-program best selection or suite GM here. Agent A independently handles profile GM.
